# docs/ — GitHub Pages output (generated)

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are build output and will be overwritten.

GitHub Pages can only serve from the repository **root** or **`/docs`** — not from
an arbitrary subdirectory like `site/`. This folder exists solely so the site is
reachable at that URL.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The whole site: one self-contained file, no server or dependencies |
| `corpus/` | One page per agent report and per run ledger (the findings explorer) |
| `.nojekyll` | Tells GitHub to serve these files verbatim instead of running Jekyll |

## How to regenerate

```powershell
npm run site             # from the repo root: export → corpus → build
```

or step by step:

```powershell
cd arena
node post.mjs            # optional: write conclusion posts for new runs
node export-site.mjs     # ledgers + posts + audit -> site/data/findings.json
node export-corpus.mjs   # report + run pages -> site/corpus/
cd ..\site
node build.mjs           # -> site/dist/index.html AND docs/index.html (+ docs/corpus/)
```

Then commit and push:

```powershell
cd ..
git add -A
git commit -m "Rebuild site"
git push
```

## Where the real source is

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| [`../site/index.html`](../site/index.html) | The site source — **edit this**, not `docs/` |
| [`../site/build.mjs`](../site/build.mjs) | Inlines the data and publishes here |
| [`../site/data/findings.json`](../site/data/findings.json) | Generated by `arena/export-site.mjs` |
| [`../site/README.md`](../site/README.md) | Full site documentation |

`build.mjs` writes both `site/dist/index.html` and this folder in a single step, so
the published copy cannot drift from the source. It also fails the build if
`site/index.html` changes in a way its rewrites do not expect, rather than silently
emitting a page that cannot load its own data.

## Pages settings

Settings → Pages → Source: **Deploy from a branch**, Branch: **`main`**, Folder: **`/docs`**.
